candidate: aT(R)=aT_native*A*(R/Rpivot)^p; Rpivot=median catalog R per galaxy; unchanged finite admission gate
new_assumptions: Phenomenological radial load response; not derived new field equation. uD(R)/uD_native=A^2*(R/Rpivot)^(2p). No total-stress conservation or lensing completion is claimed.

bounds.stellar_positivity: same source positivity lower bound for both models

full_sample: same 149-galaxy v0.1 selection, Q<=2, inclination>=30deg, >=5 valid points
clean_sample: Q=1; 40<=inclination<=80; relative distance uncertainty<=0.10; inclination uncertainty<=5deg; >=10 valid points. Quality flag proxy; no independent symmetry measurement.
heldout: For >=10 points per galaxy, sorted by radius, every fifth point (index 4,9,...) is held out; all other points train. Split fixed before fits. Radial interpolation diagnostic, not independent galaxies or pristine external validation.
metrics: raw chi2; N-k; galaxy-block AIC and BIC=sum[chi2_i+k_i log n_i]; conditional; boundary solutions reported; heldout chi2/Nheldout.
stopping: fixed stated models; do not tune further on heldout or clean-sample results
